POST to /calendars/{id}/events/quickAdd creates a new event from the text phrase.

POSTs a timeMin/timeMax/items query to the read-only /freeBusy endpoint and returns zero-or-more busy blocks per calendar; POST body is a query, not a mutation.
Same /freeBusy query over a window, then pure in-flow interval inversion/filtering; no API call mutates anything.
GET on /calendars/{id}/events/{eventId} — a single specific known resource addressed by ID.
GET on the events list endpoint with q/timeMin/timeMax/eventTypes filters, returning zero-or-more events, no mutation.
calendar.events.instances enumerates the occurrences of a series (items[] + nextPageToken, zero-or-more), read-only.
calendar.events.move relocates the event to another calendar — changes external state recoverably (moving back restores it); the same-calendar branch is only a get.
Enumerates every calendar via getCalendars then GETs each calendar's events with q=/time bounds, paging through zero-or-more matches; no mutation.
calendar.events.update writes a new event body (summary/times/attendees/permissions) — recoverable change to external state.

run() fans out dispatchToSubflow POSTs per CSV batch, each starting a new subflow run; the CSV itself is only read.
Webhook trigger: run() just returns the inbound payload and onStart only writes a FLOW-scoped store cursor; all triggers are READ.

Calls drive.files.copy to create a new Drive file from the source document; adds state, destroys nothing.
batchUpdate with an insertTable request, then a second batchUpdate of insertText cell writes; the intervening documents.get is only a read-back for indices.
Builds replaceAllText/replaceImage requests and sends documents.batchUpdate, changing existing document content recoverably.
documents.create makes a new doc, then batchUpdate inserts the converted markdown requests (common/index.ts:65).

Sends a createFooter request via documents.batchUpdate, adding a new footer segment to the document.
Sends a createFootnote request via documents.batchUpdate, adding a footnote anchor and segment.
Sends a createHeader request via documents.batchUpdate, adding a new header segment to the document.
Sends a createNamedRange request via documents.batchUpdate, adding a named range to the document.
Sends a createParagraphBullets request via documents.batchUpdate, changing paragraph list styling in place (recoverable).
Calls docsCommon.createDocument (POST /documents) then writeToDocument to insert the plain-text body.
Sends a deleteContentRange request via batchUpdate, removing document content that a retry cannot restore.
Sends a deleteFooter request via batchUpdate, removing the footer segment and its content irrecoverably.
batchUpdate issues a deleteHeader request that removes the header section and its content; a retry cannot restore it.

batchUpdate deleteNamedRange removes the addressed named-range object(s) (by id or, worse, every range sharing a name) and no retry restores them; only the underlying text survives, so a marker-style WRITE reading is possible.

batchUpdate deleteParagraphBullets only clears list formatting over a range; the paragraphs themselves survive and createParagraphBullets is the inverse, so per the reversible-marker ruling this is WRITE.
batchUpdate deleteTableColumn removes the column and all cell content at the given table cell location; unrecoverable by retry.
batchUpdate deleteTableRow removes the row and all its cell content; unrecoverable by retry.
Reads one known document by id (documents.get for title, then drive.files.export) and writes the bytes only to in-flow file storage via context.files.write; no external mutation.

Default path is a drive.files.list name-contains query returning zero-or-one match; the documents.create/insertText/files.update path sits behind the createIfNotFound checkbox (defaultValue false), so per the wave-1 opt-in ruling the default path is tagged and multiplex is flagged.
Single documents.get on a caller-supplied document id, returning the raw document JSON; no mutation.
documents.get on a specific document id, then in-memory computation of the body end index; no mutation.
documents.get on a specific document id followed by a pure in-flow flatten of paragraph text runs; no mutation.
Reads the doc only to resolve the cell index, then batchUpdate insertInlineImage adds an image to the document — creates external state recoverably.
batchUpdate with an insertInlineImage request adds an image at an index or at end of body; additive external change.
batchUpdate with an insertPageBreak request adds content to the document; additive external change.
batchUpdate with an insertTable request creates a new table in the document; additive external change.
batchUpdate with an insertTableColumn request adds a column to an existing table — recoverable state change.
batchUpdate with an insertTableRow request adds a row to an existing table — creates state, removes none.
batchUpdate with an insertText request (append or at index) adds document content.
documents.get is only used to resolve the cell index; the mutation is a batchUpdate insertText into the cell.
documents.get on a caller-supplied documentId returns one specific known resource, no mutation.
batchUpdate with a replaceAllText request updates matched text in place — a recoverable content change, no delete request.
Unconditionally queues deleteContentRange over the whole body [1, bodyEnd-1) before reinserting markdown; the prior body content is gone and a retry cannot restore it.
batchUpdate with a replaceImage request swaps the inline image's URI in place — an update, no delete request issued.
First request is an unconditional deleteContentRange over the caller's [startIndex, endIndex) span; that removed content is unrecoverable by retry, only then is markdown inserted.
drive.files.list with a name/fullText query returns zero-or-more paged results and mutates nothing.
batchUpdate unmergeTableCells splits a merged region; the cells and their content survive and mergeTableCells is the inverse, so per the reversible-marker ruling it is WRITE.
batchUpdate with an updateDocumentStyle request changes page-margin fields on the document.
batchUpdate with an updateTableRowStyle request sets minRowHeight on the named rows — a recoverable update.
Trigger (POLLING, drive.files.list on createdTime in the polling items fn) — all triggers are READ per the rubric.
run() makes no external API call — it either sleeps via setTimeout or creates a flow-internal engine waitpoint, so nothing outside the flow is created or changed (pure in-flow wait).
run() only parses the target timestamp and then sleeps or registers a flow-internal DELAY waitpoint; no external resource is read or mutated (pure in-flow wait).
